campaign: Complete integrated platform validation, then transfer audio.cpp capabilities through one native train-evaluate-serve proof and expand the shared audio substrate
doctrine: Every retained work row executes as one repeated automation cycle. First run go run ./cmd/plan -prepare-merge master -plan-projection first-parent-target; when master is not already contained, finalize the injected merge row with the exact cmd/gate -merge command printed by the owner so master code and source-store evidence enter while the audio plan remains the explicit reconciliation target. Second inspect the merged repository, query its authorities instead of inferring them, and reconcile every affected remaining row; commit the paired sync row through cmd/gate. Third perform only the paired work row and run its declared verifier. Fourth commit that work row through cmd/gate, which records evidence and prunes it atomically; then restart the cycle from the current master tip. Raw git merge, raw git commit, implementation before the paired sync row, and carrying a plan assumption across a master merge are refused. Each sync row inherits the paired work row's original dependencies, and the work row depends only on that completed sync authority. The retained integrated-validation rows remain the capability-freeze prerequisite and run before audio implementation; this branch does not evade or discard open master obligations. After they complete, audio.cpp is a pinned behavioral oracle and mechanism source, never a linked runtime, hosted server, package manager, or permanent product dependency. The transfer unit is a verified processing capability: source commit, license and artifact identity, neutral typed contract, intermediate golden traces, Go CPU reference, manifest-owned CUDA where measurement justifies it, recipe-selected consumer, evaluation evidence, and deletion of temporary comparison adapters. ASR is first because Overgo already serves and trains speech synthesis but lacks a first-class transcription lifecycle. The first elected model is a compact CTC-capable artifact selected from the pinned census by runnable artifact availability, traceability, architectural reuse, memory, and wall cost; no family name enters shared executors. Forward parity precedes backward implementation, while task, artifact, state, and checkpoint contracts retain the information required for gradients, deterministic replay, trainable-parameter selection, and optimizer state. The campaign is not complete when inference runs: its proof is a recorded audio dataset entering native training, exact stop and resume preserving optimizer, random and data-stream state, a pre/post WER bracket, and the resulting checkpoint serving through the authenticated API with complete OvergoDB lineage. CPU is the numerical authority. CUDA enters only through kernels/manifest.json and must match the CPU contract on the same artifact and fixtures. Streaming work owns bounded sessions, cancellation, chunk-boundary invariance, finalization, and backpressure. Every quality or performance claim names its artifact, dataset, environment, denominator, latency, throughput, host memory and VRAM. Later ASR, VAD, alignment, diarization, voice and generative-audio rows stay behind the first closed-loop proof so breadth cannot hide an incomplete lifecycle. Findings outside this scope are recorded but do not expand the campaign.
